component.name: DiyarDesk
component.summary: Adaptive desktop wallpaper that reshapes around your desktop icons

description.p: DiyarDesk turns the space around your desktop icons into a living interactive landscape. Move, add, or remove an icon and clouds, waves, sand dunes, snowdrifts, aurora reflections, or liquid glass panels reshape smoothly around it — locally in real time, with zero accounts and zero telemetry.

ul.li: 28 built-in adaptive themes including Liquid Glass, Studio Glass, Meadow, Beach, Aurora, Polar Night, Desert, and Rosebrook
Custom theme importer supporting .zip, .deskland, .html, .glsl/.frag shaders, images, and videos
Supports KDE Plasma 6, GNOME, COSMIC, wlroots Wayland, and X11 with multi-monitor layouts
Automatic fullscreen, battery, and session-lock pause plus Startup Crash Sentinel (Safe Mode)
Privacy-safe desktop snapshot and video sharing with synthetic placeholder icons

screenshot.caption: Adaptive Meadow scene reacting to desktop icon placement
Frozen fjord Aurora theme wrapping around icons
Overhead Sahara Desert dunes forming beneath icons

ul.li: Added Smart Icon Islands clustering and Universal Audio Beat reactivity (Windows Core Audio loopback peak + Rust OpenGL pulse shader)
Added Meeting / Game automatic pause rules (camera/mic & custom process detection) and Windows Desktop Icon Layout snapshot save & restore
Added .deskland-preset v2 sharing, 9:16 vertical showcase export with live RAM badges, offline drag-and-drop import, and live RAM comparison cards
Added interactive 2-question first-run onboarding wizard, theme category filters, curated style presets, Seasonal Atmosphere mode, and Window-Aware v2 for AI Mascots & Cat Shore
Added bidirectional Android Tablet <-> Desktop LAN Handoff with Impulse widget state sync and WCAG AA accessibility polish
Added inactive OpenGL theme renderer eviction on theme switch to reduce GPU VRAM and host RAM across Windows, Linux, Android, and macOS

Added zero-WebView hardware-accelerated video wallpaper backends across all 4 platforms: Android MediaPlayer, Windows WPF MediaElement (+ mpv.exe), Linux libmpv Gtk.GLArea / GStreamer on Wayland & X11, and macOS AVQueuePlayer
Ported the native Rust + OpenGL 3.3 Core engine (libdiyardesk_gl.dylib) to macOS alongside live RAM badges and Light / Medium / Heavy memory tier tags
Brought native Rust + OpenGL ES 3.0 (16 KB page-aligned) and fast baked Eye Within Words / Cosmic Eye themes to Android tablets
Ported the native Rust + OpenGL 3.3 Core wallpaper engine (libdiyardesk_gl.so) to Linux with zero-WebKit GTK3 settings, Wayland FrameClock pacing, and hybrid KDE Plasma 6 QML support

Added two new native Rust + OpenGL 3.3 themes: Shore Cat (cat-shore) with cursor-tracking cat and collapsible top productivity notch bar, and Persephone Silver Engraving (persephone) with real-time spark-traced contours
Added native Linux virtual desktop icons with renaming, iconless GNOME/Hyprland/Niri/Sway support, and upgraded TR/DE/EN language detection in Frontline Pocket
Upgraded Liquid Glass and Studio Glass with dual-zone Snell optical refraction and 3D studio objects
Added Linux COSMIC Wayland desktop support and Startup Crash Sentinel (Safe Mode)
Added Theme SDK documentation, privacy policy, and contributor guidelines
